subject.title: feat(openrouter): forward OpenClaw session id as session_id

question: Should the OpenRouter plugin expose an opt-in setting that forwards the raw OpenClaw session id, or should any sticky-routing value be a provider-specific opaque derived identifier?
rationale: This is an intentional external metadata-egress and plugin-config contract; source-level checks can confirm implementation mechanics but cannot choose the acceptable privacy, observability, and support boundary.

options.title: Use an opaque derived identifier
options.body: Keep the opt-in feature but derive a stable OpenRouter-specific value so sticky routing works without exporting the internal session identifier.

options.title: Approve raw session-id forwarding
options.body: Accept the raw identifier as an explicit, documented operator-controlled OpenRouter integration contract.

options.title: Decline this config surface
options.body: Do not add forwarding until maintainers choose a broader provider-context egress design.

recommendation.title: Use an opaque derived identifier
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in feature but derive a stable OpenRouter-specific value so sticky routing works without exporting the internal session identifier.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline explicitly routes the unresolved OpenRouter decision to this participant.
